news.titleEn: Nasdaq slides 2% Friday to post worst week since June, pressured by AI sell-off and oil prices: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq fell 2.14% and the S&P 500 1.09% on Friday, capping both indexes' worst week since June as chipmakers extended their losing streak.
news.conclusionZh: 纳指周五跌2.1%，标普与纳指录得6月以来最差单周
news.whyEn: Doubts about whether the AI build-out can earn a return are now hitting the market's biggest weights, while $100 oil adds inflation pressure.
news.whyZh: 市场开始怀疑AI投资能否回本，叠加百元油价，权重科技股承压
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 closed at 7,659.44, the Nasdaq at 26,140.03 and the Dow slipped 0.34% to 52,002.41. Chip stocks fell for an eighth straight session, their longest slide since 2008, with Micron down about 5.6% and Intel about 5.8%. Investors are questioning whether AI infrastructure spending has outrun companies' ability to monetize it. Energy was the bright spot as crude rose on Middle East supply risks, and next week's earnings from Tesla, Meta and others will test sentiment.
news.detailZh: 标普500收于7659.44点，纳指收于26140.03点，道指跌0.34%至52002.41点。芯片股连续第八个交易日下跌，创2008年以来最长连跌，美光跌约5.6%，英特尔跌约5.8%。投资者担心AI基础设施投入已超出企业的变现能力。能源板块因中东供应风险逆势上涨，下周特斯拉、Meta等公司财报将进一步检验市场情绪。

news.titleEn: One Singapore ship was sunk, but here's why others are still transiting the Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: A Singapore-flagged container ship and a bulk carrier sank near the Strait of Hormuz after being hit by projectiles, as attacks on shipping hit a record.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡两船遇袭沉没，航运袭击创纪录
news.whyEn: Hormuz carries a large share of global oil and LNG; the attacks keep Brent near $110 and stoke inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 全球大量油气经此运输，袭击令布油逼近110美元，推高全球通胀
news.detailEn: The Singapore-flagged GFS Pride caught fire and sank, with all 21 crew evacuated, and a dry bulk carrier also went down in a separate incident. Iran says it is stepping up strikes in response to the US blockade of its ports and tougher sanctions imposed last month; CENTCOM reportedly attributed the sinking to an Iranian projectile rather than a mine. Brent traded around $109 and WTI above $100 on Friday. Many vessels are still transiting, but insurance and freight costs are rising sharply.
news.detailZh: 新加坡籍集装箱船GFS Pride起火沉没，21名船员全部撤离，另一艘散货船也在另一起事件中沉没。伊朗称加大袭击是为回应美国对其港口的封锁和上月加码的制裁；据报美军中央司令部认定是伊朗发射物而非水雷所致。周五布伦特原油约109美元，WTI在100美元以上。仍有不少船只冒险通行，但保险和运费正急剧上涨。

news.titleEn: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening
news.conclusionEn: Speaking at the IMF-World Bank meetings, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh stressed delivering price stability but gave no hint on whether the Fed will hike again in October.
news.conclusionZh: 沃什强调稳物价，但未透露10月是否加息
news.whyEn: With CPI at 3.7% and PPI at 6.3%, the timing of the next Fed hike drives Treasury yields, the dollar and equity valuations.
news.whyZh: CPI达3.7%、PPI达6.3%，下一次加息时点牵动美债、美元和股市
news.detailEn: Warsh said the Fed had made clear it would deliver price stability and welcomed tightening by other central banks, but repeated that it is no longer in the forward-guidance business. September CPI rose 3.7% year on year and producer prices jumped 6.3%. Traders read his reticence as pointing to a hold at the late-October meeting, which falls less than a week before the November 3 midterms, with a December hike still widely expected.
news.detailZh: 沃什表示美联储已明确会实现物价稳定，并对其他央行的紧缩表示欢迎，但重申不再提供前瞻指引。9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，PPI同比上涨6.3%。交易员将其表态解读为10月下旬会议可能按兵不动，该会议距11月3日中期选举不到一周，市场仍普遍预期12月加息。

news.titleEn: Taiwan to Curb AI Chip Exports to China as Part of US Trade Deal
news.conclusionEn: Taiwan will add advanced chips and AI servers to its export-control list, making unauthorized shipments to China a potential criminal offense.
news.conclusionZh: 台湾将管制对大陆出口先进AI芯片和服务器
news.whyEn: It closes a smuggling route for Nvidia-powered servers and deepens the tech split between the US bloc and China.
news.whyZh: 堵住英伟达服务器走私渠道，加深中美科技阵营分化
news.detailEn: Economic Affairs Minister Kung Ming-hsin said advanced semiconductors and AI servers will be added to the controlled-items list, with violations prosecutable under the Foreign Trade Act. The rules would move from a company blacklist to a ban covering all Chinese buyers. The move is part of commitments under the Taiwan-US reciprocal trade agreement and follows August indictments over an alleged AI-server smuggling scheme. Beijing is likely to react, and supply-chain firms may face tighter compliance checks.
news.detailZh: 台湾经济部长龚明鑫表示，将把先进半导体和AI服务器纳入管制清单，违规出口可依《贸易法》追究刑责。规则将从针对特定企业的黑名单扩大为覆盖所有大陆买家。此举属于台美对等贸易协定的承诺内容，此前8月曾有人因涉嫌走私AI服务器被起诉。北京可能作出反应，供应链企业的合规审查也将趋严。

news.titleEn: EU Leaders Rally Around Zelenskiy as Trump Calls Ukrainian Strikes on Russia a 'Disgrace'
news.conclusionEn: EU leaders backed Zelenskiy at a Brussels summit after Trump called Ukraine's renewed strikes on Russian refineries a 'disgrace' for pushing up oil prices.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普痛批乌袭俄炼厂，欧盟峰会力挺泽连斯基
news.whyEn: A widening US-Europe split over Ukraine affects energy prices, defense spending and the future of Western support for Kyiv.
news.whyZh: 美欧在乌克兰问题上分歧扩大，牵动油价、军费和援乌前景
news.detailEn: Trump had announced last weekend that Ukraine and Russia agreed not to hit each other's energy facilities, but Zelenskiy ordered strikes on Russian refineries to resume. Trump told Newsmax the strikes were just making world oil prices higher, ahead of November midterms where energy costs are a political issue. European Council chief Antonio Costa said now is the time to increase support for Ukraine, and EU officials suggest a new loan to Kyiv will likely be needed.
news.detailZh: 特朗普上周末宣布俄乌同意互不打击能源设施，但泽连斯基下令恢复对俄炼油厂的打击。特朗普接受Newsmax采访时称这只会推高国际油价，而能源价格是11月中期选举的敏感议题。欧洲理事会主席科斯塔表示，现在应加大对乌支持，欧盟官员也暗示很可能需要向乌提供新贷款。

news.titleEn: BOJ's Ueda Says He Cannot Tolerate Inflation Rising Above 2%
news.conclusionEn: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said he cannot tolerate underlying inflation rising further above 2%, a hawkish signal that lifted the yen.
news.conclusionZh: 植田和男称不能容忍通胀进一步超2%，日元走强
news.whyEn: Further BOJ hikes could unwind yen-funded carry trades and push up global bond yields.
news.whyZh: 日本央行若继续加息，可能引发日元套息交易平仓、推高全球债息
news.detailEn: Ueda said underlying inflation is already roughly at 2% and he would not accept it climbing further. Board member Junko Koeda separately warned against being overly cautious on rate hikes given substantial upside risks to prices. The BOJ raised rates in September, and many officials reportedly prefer to wait at the October 29-30 meeting. USD/JPY traded near 157.85 as the yen firmed on the hawkish tone.
news.detailZh: 植田表示，基础通胀已大致在2%左右，不会接受其进一步上升。审议委员小枝淳子也警告，鉴于物价上行风险较大，加息不必过度谨慎。日本央行9月刚加息，据报不少官员倾向于在10月29-30日会议上暂时观望。受鹰派言论提振，美元兑日元在157.85附近。

news.titleEn: Wall Street's fear gauge is ripping. Traders see it going even higher
news.conclusionEn: The Cboe Volatility Index jumped above 22 for the first time in four months, and options traders are positioning for further spikes.
news.conclusionZh: VIX恐慌指数四个月来首次突破22，交易员押注继续上升
news.whyEn: Rising volatility raises hedging costs and often forces systematic funds to cut equity exposure, amplifying sell-offs.
news.whyZh: 波动率上升推高对冲成本，可能迫使量化基金减仓，放大跌势
news.detailEn: The sell-off in AI-related names pushed the VIX above 22 for the first time since June. Traders are positioning for volatility to climb further heading into a heavy week of big-tech earnings. Higher oil, sticky inflation and uncertainty over the Fed's next move are all feeding demand for protection.
news.detailZh: AI相关股票遭抛售，令VIX自6月以来首次升破22。交易员押注在下周科技巨头密集财报前恐慌情绪进一步升温。油价上涨、通胀顽固以及美联储下一步动向不明，都在推升避险需求。

news.titleEn: Anything not tied to artificial intelligence took off this week
news.conclusionEn: Stocks outside the AI trade beat the broader market by one of the widest margins in nearly three years this week.
news.conclusionZh: 非AI股本周跑赢大盘，幅度为近三年最大之一
news.whyEn: It signals money rotating out of crowded AI winners into overlooked sectors, a shift that could reshape portfolio leadership.
news.whyZh: 显示资金从拥挤的AI股流向被忽视板块，市场领涨格局或生变
news.detailEn: Leading non-AI gainers in the S&P 500 this week included Fair Isaac, up almost 14%, Equifax up 10.4%, Darden Restaurants up 10.3% and Brown-Forman up 9%. The rotation came as chipmakers and AI infrastructure names sold off on return-on-investment worries. Whether it lasts will depend on next week's earnings and whether AI spending guidance holds up.
news.detailZh: 本周标普500中表现最好的非AI股包括Fair Isaac涨近14%、Equifax涨10.4%、达登餐饮涨10.3%、百富门涨9%。与此同时，芯片和AI基础设施股因投资回报担忧遭抛售。这种轮动能否持续，取决于下周财报以及AI资本开支指引是否稳得住。

news.titleEn: U.S. Treasury yields inch lower as investors digest hot inflation data
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield edged down to about 5.07% as investors weighed hot CPI and PPI readings against Warsh's lack of rate guidance.
news.conclusionZh: 美债10年期收益率小幅回落至约5.07%
news.whyEn: Yields above 5% raise borrowing costs for mortgages, companies and governments and pressure stock valuations.
news.whyZh: 5%以上的美债收益率推高房贷、企业及政府融资成本，压制估值
news.detailEn: The benchmark 10-year yield slipped about 1 basis point to 5.074% on Friday, after falling roughly 9 basis points the prior session, while the 30-year was little changed near 5.42%. This week's data showed wholesale inflation posting its biggest gain since 2022. Safe-haven demand during the tech rout has helped cap yields, but persistent inflation keeps the risk of further Fed hikes alive.
news.detailZh: 周五10年期美债收益率下滑约1个基点至5.074%，前一交易日已回落约9个基点；30年期收益率在5.42%附近基本持平。本周数据显示批发通胀录得2022年以来最大涨幅。科技股下跌带来的避险需求压低了收益率，但通胀顽固意味着美联储进一步加息的风险依然存在。

news.titleEn: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Tesla, SpaceX, Alcoa, CoreWeave, Travelers & more
news.conclusionEn: Tesla shares climbed nearly 5% after it unveiled its long-awaited second-generation Roadster, while Alcoa rose on a third-quarter earnings beat.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉发布第二代Roadster，股价涨近5%
news.whyEn: Tesla is a heavyweight in US indexes and reports earnings next week; the Roadster refreshes its product story amid the tech sell-off.
news.whyZh: 特斯拉是美股权重股且下周发财报，新车为其增长故事加分
news.detailEn: Tesla finally showed the second-generation Roadster, years after the original prototype was first promised. The stock bucked the tech sell-off ahead of its quarterly results on Wednesday. Alcoa gained more than 2% after better-than-expected third-quarter earnings. Investors will look for whether Tesla can turn halo products into meaningful revenue.
news.detailZh: 特斯拉在原型车亮相多年后终于正式发布第二代Roadster。该股在科技股普跌中逆势上涨，下周三将公布季度财报。美铝第三季度业绩好于预期，股价涨超2%。投资者将关注特斯拉能否把这类旗舰产品转化为实质收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: Scenario planning means sketching a few plausible futures (for example, best case, base case and stress case) and deciding in advance how you would act in each. Instead of betting everything on one forecast, you identify the key uncertainties and the early signals that tell you which scenario is unfolding. It makes organizations faster and calmer when conditions change suddenly.
businessTips.explanationZh: 情景规划是指设想几种可能的未来（如乐观、基准、压力情景），并提前决定每种情况下怎么做。它不把一切押在单一预测上，而是找出关键不确定因素，以及判断哪种情景正在发生的早期信号。这样在环境突变时，组织能更快、更冷静地应对。
businessTips.exampleEn: With oil swinging between $90 and $126 this year, an airline might plan for $80, $110 and $140 fuel. Each scenario comes with pre-agreed actions such as hedging levels, fare surcharges or route cuts, triggered when prices cross set thresholds.
businessTips.exampleZh: 今年油价在90到126美元之间大幅波动，航空公司可以按80、110、140美元三种油价做规划。每种情景都预先定好对应动作，如对冲比例、燃油附加费或削减航线，油价一越过阈值就执行。

businessTips.explanationEn: White labeling means selling a product or service made by another company under your own brand. You skip manufacturing or building the core technology and focus on branding, a niche audience and marketing. Margins depend on your positioning, so the real asset you build is the brand and customer relationships.
businessTips.explanationZh: 白标是指把别家公司生产的产品或服务贴上自己的品牌来卖。你不需要自己制造或开发核心技术，而是专注于品牌、细分人群和营销。利润取决于你的定位，所以真正积累的资产是品牌和客户关系。
businessTips.exampleEn: A fitness coach could sell a white-label protein powder or a branded workout app built on a third-party platform to followers. A freelance designer might resell a white-label SEO service to clients, adding a markup while the provider does the delivery.
businessTips.exampleZh: 健身教练可以向粉丝出售贴牌蛋白粉，或基于第三方平台做一个自有品牌的训练App。自由设计师也可以把白标SEO服务转卖给客户，由服务商交付，自己赚取差价。

businessTips.explanationEn: Market breadth measures how many stocks are participating in a move, not just how the index performs; an index propped up by a few giants has narrow breadth. Sector rotation is when money shifts from one group of stocks to another as the economic or sentiment backdrop changes. Watching both helps investors tell whether a sell-off is broad-based or a reshuffling of leadership.
businessTips.explanationZh: 市场宽度衡量的是有多少股票参与涨跌，而不只看指数表现；如果指数只靠少数巨头撑着，宽度就很窄。板块轮动是指随着经济或情绪变化，资金从一类股票转向另一类。同时观察两者，能帮助判断一轮下跌是全面抛售，还是领涨股在换位。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week the Nasdaq fell sharply on chip stocks, yet non-AI names like Equifax and Darden jumped by double digits. That pattern suggests rotation rather than a broad panic, and investors heavily concentrated in AI might use it as a cue to review diversification.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周纳指因芯片股大跌，但Equifax、达登等非AI股却涨了两位数。这更像是板块轮动而非全面恐慌，重仓AI的投资者可以借此检视自己的分散配置。
